overview: The Katta Archives safeguard the historical, political, and arcane records of the Loyalist Republic.
history: Founded alongside the Senate Hall to preserve Loyalist doctrine.
Expanded with arcane vaults to store dangerous or powerful tomes.
Archivists developed warded cataloging systems to prevent tampering.
The Archives became a central hub for scholars, senators, and arcane researchers.
hooks: A forbidden tome destabilizes its containment ward.
A Senate decree goes missing from the sealed vault.
An archivist reports strange whispers from the Deep Stacks.
A magical anomaly spreads through the cataloging hall.
